_comment_warm_start_dir: warm_start.checkpoint_dir uses the FULL path (model_checkpoints/... prefix included, matching eval's checkpoint.checkpoint_dir convention verbatim) -- this project's own train-mode checkpoint_dir does NOT include that prefix (setup_checkpoint_dir() adds it automatically). Do not confuse the two.
_comment_source: Source checkpoint is the depth=8 3-way-combo run (num_transitions=3, untied_norm, expansion=8), 45.00%/69.33% top-1/top-5 at epoch 50 on real ImageNet-1K. That checkpoint is never written to by this config -- see config.py's warm_start validation.
